name: Ookami
source:
A weak-bodied young boy wearing a wolf-design hood. He doesn't have much energy or strength. At a first glance, he seems like a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herbivore_men]herbivorous guy[/URL], but on the inside, he's masculine.

[SPOILER]His actual last name is "大神 (Oogami)", and he's childhood friends with Akazukin (the actual wolf in Taishou x Alice). They haven't been in contact with one another ever since Oogami's grandmother fell ill.[/SPOILER]

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.primula.jpn.com/taishoalice/chara08a.html]official website profile[/URL].]
